What is Kirsten Gillibrand's position on "Make voter registration easier"?[/INST] Kirsten Gillibrand opposes "Make voter registration easier".
Output:
This position is based on her objection to a specific amendment during the confirmation of Xavier Becerra as Secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services in 2017.

On February 15, 2017, during the Senate confirmation hearing for Xavier Becerra, a Democratic amendment was proposed to make voter registration easier by allowing the use of federal forms for voter registration (S.Amdt. 10). The amendment was sponsored by Senators Tom Udall (D-NM) and Brian Schatz (D-HI). Gillibrand was one of the senators who voted against this amendment.

Source: Congressional Record, Volume 163, Number 28, February 15, 2017, page S2211, available at https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CREC-2017
